propositions: make amend-msg preserves Change-Id from HEAD but silently drops Signed-off-by trailers by the same wholesale message replacement mechanism it was designed to prevent for Change-Id

the tool's docstring and stated rationale acknowledge the Signed-off-by trailer block exists and is mandatory, yet the wrapper implementation carries forward only Change-Id and leaves Signed-off-by drop reachable
no CI gate or commit hook validates Signed-off-by presence, so the silent loss is undetected until manual inspection or later enforcement
compose_message() must extract and re-attach all Signed-off-by trailers from HEAD when the author's new message file omits them, matching Change-Id carry-forward semantics
a replacement message file that includes its own Signed-off-by must be respected as authoritative and not duplicated, and multiple distinct sign-offs on HEAD must all survive the amend
